method: 60native wall-clock seconds at the same explicitly labelled diagnostic initial station. Actual AutoWalk button from5to30s, contemplative stop, real V camera changes at40and50s. No position mutation during the movie, no forced itinerary or rare events, no acceleration. Canvas up to8fps plus real post-limiter Opus. Software native timings include UI/recording/streaming and are not a per-frame matched-position GPU benchmark.
